2026.title: Three columns side by side
2026.body:
This site is now running as a static perpetual archive—zero third-party databases, plain JSON files, and client-side AES-256-GCM encryption whenever I want entries sealed.

Try **highlighting any sentence** in this column to quote it into a margin comment below, or click **Write Entry** to add a new year or attach a drag-aligned photograph.

comments.author: Self
comments.body: Still holds true two years later. Looking across all three columns makes the long arc obvious in a single glance.

quote.text: The value of a daily record is rarely visible in the same week you write it; it reveals itself three Novembers later.
